summary: Iteration 71: Full testing of location permission flow and safe zone management features. All features verified working correctly - web location permission guide with Ouvrir Reglages/Reessayer buttons, glass popup safe zone manager with CRUD operations, and backend geofence APIs.

web_location_permission_guide.details: Guide displays on first launch with 'Activer la localisation' title, 'Ouvrir Reglages' and 'Reessayer' buttons working

beneficiary_detail_safezone_section.details: Safe zone section inline with refresh, Gerer buttons. Shows zone count and beneficiary position

safezone_popup_glass_manager.details: Glass popup opens from Gerer button with all elements: title, subtitle, close btn, location card, Actualiser, Verifier zone, Ajouter une zone buttons

safezone_crud_operations.details: Create, Edit, Toggle, Delete all functional via popup. Zone form has name, lat, lng, radius inputs with save/cancel

safezone_location_status.details: Shows 'Localisation non disponible. Le beneficiaire doit accepter la localisation (Toujours).' when location unavailable

critical_code_review_comments: Web location permission guide properly blocks UI until permission is granted/denied - correctly implements UX requirement
Safe zone manager popup is full-featured glass modal replacing broken page navigation - correct fix
data-testid attributes properly implemented on all interactive elements for automated testing
seed_data_creation: Test zones created during testing were deleted after verification
